items.title: OpenAI CLI
items.blurb: Official CLI for the OpenAI API. Contribute to openai/openai-cli development by creating an account on GitHub.

items.title: Claude Duet
items.blurb: Claude Duet is a personal AI agent you message. It handles your inbox, calendar and follow-ups and messages you when something needs you. Join the waitlist.

items.title: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE in PHP
items.blurb: Core PHP engine flaws enable remote code execution and Heartbleed-style memory disclosure across the web.

items.title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
Presentation: Actors for Agents: Patterns for Production AI
items.blurb: Manju Rajashekhar explains how the actor model solves the complex runtime challenges of production AI agents.

items.title: Article: AI Changes the Data Interface, Not the Query Engine
items.blurb: This article presents a disaster-recovery analytics workflow in which an AI agent generates constrained SQL or Python, DuckDB computes reproducible facts from Parquet, and the agent interprets the results.

items.title: Harbor Adds Docker Sandboxes to Run Reproducible AI Agent Evals in Isolated MicroVMs
items.blurb: Docker announced that Harbor, the open-source agent evaluation framework, now works with Docker Sandboxes. This change allows each evaluation task to run in its own microVM.

items.title: Developer Behind the AI-Built Adobe Clones Says They Are “Not Anywhere Close to Ready
items.blurb: A developer used Claude Opus 5.5 to build open-source replacements for seven Adobe applications, promoted them across Reddit with a projection of roughly 100% parity within a month, then told Hacker News the project was not anywhere close…

items.title: Garmin Revamps and Opens Up Connect Developer API Program
items.blurb: Not exactly related to programming, but as a Garmin user I've always wanted an API for personal access so I can make my own stuff on top of it. I also really like the fact that they have a tier specifically targeting personal use.

items.title: Who is Issac Newton or Davinci of programming/CS?
items.blurb: Popular names appear to be Linus or Dennis but who do you think is Newton/Davinci of CS/computer programming as in the best mankind has produced up to this point in that field?
